_comment: Phase 1 buildable lair + Phase 4 economy swap. Each station is a placeable InteractableObject (LairStation) built in the lair with build mode ([B]); interacting ([F]) opens its focused panel ('panel' routes to the HUD opener: process/goblins/upgrades/missions/fabricator). 'free':true + no cost = pre-placed on a fresh lair and free to (re)build; the rest cost base chain products. The old recycler Workshop + Component Exchange were retired with the economy swap — the Process Line is now the free, pre-placed production station. Icons fall back to a coloured square until art lands.

line.name: Process Line
line.desc: The production floor — chain scrap into products.

missions.name: Mission Board
missions.desc: Colony quests and the lair-restoration goal.

quarters.name: Goblin Quarters
quarters.desc: Recruit goblins, equip and upgrade their tools.

upgrades.name: Upgrade Bench
upgrades.desc: Spend Tech Data + products on permanent upgrades.
